description: This file declares functions and structures related to request pooling and management in the lighttpd server, specifically handling request configurations and lifecycle operations.

methods.name: request_config_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for a given request configuration.

methods.name: request_config_reset
methods.description: Resets a request structure to its default or initial state.

methods.name: request_init_data
methods.description: Initializes request data structures for a new request, associating it with a connection and server.

methods.name: request_reset
methods.description: Resets the request object to a clean state.

methods.name: request_reset_ex
methods.description: Extended reset for a request object, potentially with additional cleanup.

methods.name: request_release
methods.description: Releases resources held by a request.

methods.name: request_acquire
methods.description: Acquires a request structure, possibly from a pool, associated with a connection.

methods.name: request_free_data
methods.description: Frees data associated with a request.

methods.name: request_pool_free
methods.description: Frees the entire request pool or related resources.
